source='''def transform(grid):
    # The solid horizontal divider separates two panels. Compare how much
    # each marked vertical line grows from the upper panel to the lower one.
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, grid[divider][0])})
    changes = {}
    for color in colors:
        upper = sum(cell == color for row in grid[:divider] for cell in row)
        lower = sum(cell == color for row in grid[divider + 1:] for cell in row)
        changes[color] = lower - upper
    winner = max(colors, key=lambda color: changes[color])
    return [[winner, winner], [winner, winner]]
'''
